title: Exact-term lexical recall vs embedding drift
description: A distinctive exact token (key code) whose semantic near-neighbors are empty; only the 10.8 lexical tsquery side can surface it. Tests that lexical recall survives.

transcript.content: Need to write down access info before the office move.
My key card code for the west wing is XQ7K-429, and the spare gate PIN is 9012.
The moves team will need that west wing code on the day.
